title: JEPA for astronomy: multi-survey spectral alignment puts stellar parameters on the leading principal axes
abstract: arXiv:2611.23492v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spectra from different surveys carry different systematics and are not calibrated against one another. Multi-survey foundation models for stellar spectra are then built by aligning embeddings of the same star observed across surveys. Most in astronomy follow the recipes established for language and vision, aligning with a contrastive loss that separates every star from the others. However, this does not ensure that the stellar physics is encoded in a form that a simple read-out can recover. Holding the cross-survey architecture fixed and varying only the alignment loss, we measure what an objective encodes from the principal-component geometry of the Gaia BP/RP (XP) spectra and from a linear probe of the stellar parameters. translated_title: 面向天文学的JEPA：多巡天光谱对齐使恒星参数落在主成分的前几个主轴上
translated_abstract: 来自不同巡天的光谱携带不同的系统误差，且彼此之间未经相互校准。因此，面向恒星光谱的多巡天基础模型是通过在嵌入空间中对齐同一恒星在不同巡天中的观测来构建的。天文学领域的大多数方法遵循为语言和视觉领域确立的方案，采用对比损失进行对齐，将每颗恒星与其他恒星区分开来。然而，这并不能保证恒星物理信息被编码成可以通过简单读出即可恢复的形式。在保持跨巡天架构不变、仅改变对齐损失的条件下，我们通过Gaia BP/RP (XP)光谱的主成分几何结构以及恒星参数的线性探针，来衡量不同目标函数各自编码了哪些信息。在一个恰当对齐的嵌入空间中，前两个主成分构成一个平面，能够恢复出Kiel图（有效温度–表面重力图）的类似物；第三个主成分追踪金属丰度[Fe/H]，而[alpha/Fe]在整个平面上连贯地变化。
tldr: 该论文提出将JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）而非对比学习用于多巡天恒星光谱对齐，使恒星物理参数（如有效温度、表面重力、[Fe/H]和[alpha/Fe]）恰好落在嵌入空间的前几个主成分轴上，从而仅通过线性读出即可恢复Kiel图等恒星物理结构。
en_tdlr: Replacing contrastive learning with JEPA-style alignment for multi-survey stellar spectra places stellar physical parameters (Teff, logg, [Fe/H], [alpha/Fe]) onto the leading principal axes of the embedding space, enabling linear recovery of the Kiel diagram and other stellar physics.
